description: This file defines classes and functions related to the Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) state management in PyTorch's distributed training framework, including context management, hooks, and lazy initialization logic.

classes.name: FSDPStateContext
classes.description: Shared state across FSDP states, including tracking of all states, forward root, and callback flags.

classes.name: FSDPState
classes.description: Represents the state of a Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) module, including lazy initialization, hooks, and backward logic.

methods.name: disable_if_config_true
methods.description: Decorator that disables a function if torch._dynamo.config.skip_fsdp_hooks is True.

methods.name: FSDPState._lazy_init
methods.description: Performs lazy initialization of the FSDP state, determining root status and module states.

methods.name: FSDPState._pre_forward
methods.description: Pre-forward hook handling input casting, synchronization, and context setup.

methods.name: FSDPState._post_forward
methods.description: Post-forward hook handling output processing, resharding, and cleanup.

methods.name: FSDPState._pre_backward
methods.description: Pre-backward hook to prepare for backward pass, including prefetching.

methods.name: FSDPState._root_post_backward_final_callback
methods.description: Final callback after backward pass to finalize states and cleanup.

methods.name: FSDPState._finalize_backward
methods.description: Finalizes backward state, warns if modules did not run forward.

methods.name: FSDPState._register_pre_backward_hook
methods.description: Registers hooks on tensors requiring gradients for pre-backward processing.

methods.name: FSDPState._register_root_post_backward_final_callback
methods.description: Queues the final callback after backward for cleanup.

methods.name: _get_module_fsdp_state
methods.description: Retrieves the FSDPState associated with a module, if any.

methods.name: _register_group_forward_hooks
methods.description: Registers group forward pre- and post-hooks for a sequence of modules.
